title: Experts disagree on gate job in .github/workflows/ci.yml
context:
Chief architect: the two claims agree that a skipped matrix is allowed only when it chains back to a real full test run on an identical tree; this is a pick only because a must-level security finding cannot be merged by the chair. The security claim is recommended because it adds the negative tests (base not green, tree mismatch); the architect's gate rule is already carried by EX-devops-engineer-2, EX-devops-engineer-6 and EX-user-flow-writer-6

Target: gate job in .github/workflows/ci.yml
- security-auditor: a gate that went green because the matrix was skipped (D3, D4) is a derived green; it is only sound because each skip re-proves an earlier green tree, so a test must show a base that is not green, or a tree mismatch, never yields a skipped matrix
- application-architect: gate reports success with test and merge skipped only when scope proved an identical green tree (D4) or a version-only diff on a green base (D3); since ci-green trusts the gate names, every skip path must chain back to a real full test run, never to another skip without a tree match
